title: Silent Night
verse: Si- lent night, ~ ho- ly night, ~ All is calm, all is bright, Round yon Vir- gin Mo- ther and Child, ~ Ho- ly In- fant so ten- der and mild, Sleep in hea- ven- ly peace, ~ Sleep ~ in hea- ven- ly peace. ~
$lyrics: How many of the track's timed lyric lines are these lines: chart.py times them as the chart does, so Riff Lyrics and Riff Sing show the same words at the same moment.
